EXPS3-0: 68 MOA ring and 1 MOA dot

sources.publisher: EOTECH operator manual, served by OpticsPlanet
establishes: Equipment description, printed page 5: nominal envelope
Display window, printed page 6: 30 x 23 mm, front glass 3.17 mm and rear laminate 4.76 mm
Optical reticle is a projected virtual image, not a physical mesh on the glass
sources.unitConflict: The same window line prints 1.20 x 0.85 inches and 30 x 23 mm; these are not exact conversions. Art retains nominal30x23mm physical panes; clear bezel opening is separately photo-inferred at30x22mm. The inconsistent manual line does not certify either as an exact clear-bore specification.

sources.publisher: Militia Armory, higher-resolution copies of EOTECH product photography

photoRights: Photographs remain their owners’ reference material. They are not committed, embedded in the Blender file, used as textures, or shipped in the GLB. Original geometry, finishes, warning text and vector mark reconstruction only; EOTECH identifies the reference subject, not endorsement.

method.projection: Estimated orthographic profile cameras, uniform scale from nominal overall dimensions and fixed rail/body landmarks. No independent X/Y image scaling; no per-part registration. Photo perspective/lens distortion is unknown.
method.cameraPolicy: Frozen camera/scale settings in tools/blender/exps3.py for all profile comparisons. Initial-blockout screenshots rerendered using the same final studio exposure and cameras.
method.mask: Alpha > 250, then flood-fill exterior background and fill enclosed holes to isolate external profile. Faint reference drop shadows excluded; transparent optical apertures are NOT assessed by this statistic.
method.metric: Intersection-over-union of the filled masks at original image resolution, without cropping/reframing either image. Descriptive comparison only, not an automatic visual-acceptance threshold or proof of 1:1 accuracy.
method.lighting: One shared original studio, AgX Medium High Contrast, exposure -1.5; no attempt to claim identical illumination to the photographer.

measuredEnvelopeMm.note: Width includes the raised polarity marking; manufacturer envelope is rounded. Not engineering or installation tolerances.

repeatBuild.host: Linux x86_64, same host, independent factory-empty processes and empty output directories
repeatBuild.result: Byte-identical GLBs and finish PNGs for independent builds, one with all seven renders and one without rendering. Therefore geometry, indices, UVs/normals, materials/maps and socket transforms are identical. Not a universal cross-host determinism claim.
repeatBuild.authoringUVs: Native Blender UV projection uses a 1/65536 binary UV lattice, including Boolean-interpolated UVs, before save/render/export. No GLB rewriting or exporter hooks.

ocioCompatibility.reason: This host ships Blender OCIO 2.5 configuration with OCIO library 2.4.2. Default config fails; color management was NOT disabled.
ocioCompatibility.processLocal: OCIO=/tmp/exps3-ocio/config.ocio, with luts/ and filmic/ pointing at installed Blender data; AgX preserved.

limitations: Original reference-backed game art, not manufacturer CAD, a scan, or claimed final human visual acceptance.

48.2mm optical centre above the existing art datum and30x22mm clear opening are provisionally inferred from registered photos. Manufacturer specs do not certify these datums. Confirm actual mounting/rail seating and M4 ADS/co-witness separately.
Window curvature, internal holographic laminate/laser, hidden battery internals, exact fastener threads and detailed mount tolerances are not reconstructed.
Public photos are not calibrated views; silhouettes and apparent small features do not certify all dimensions or surface finish.
Glass uses a single neutral AR-tinted PBR approximation for front glass and rear laminate; a spectral AR coating and real hologram are not simulated.
No price, purchase rules, mounted gameplay model, ADS/reticle implementation, stat effects or default-M4 change in this asset-first PR.

windowRefinement.reason: Owner reported bulky front frame/sight-window obstruction; independent oracle confirmed geometry rather than a camera/shader-only issue.

revised.status: clear opening and centre inferred from registered photos; not an approved ADS/eye-box specification
revised.carrierHeightReason: 30.4mm, rather than the oracle's initial30.2mm candidate, seats its lower edge on the unchanged33mm electronics housing roof.

windowRefinement.fixedConditions: Outer hood/envelope, mounting origin, fore/aft pane locations, pane sizes/thicknesses, registered cameras, studio/exposure, material settings and embedded maps unchanged. No runtime reticle or ADS change.
windowRefinement.windowMeasurementMethod: Connected transparent window component (alpha<250, 4-connected flood from front[350,250], rear[800,380]); compared with glass-hidden opaque-geometry renders, not a material-alpha change. Masks must not connect to exterior. Same full-resolution registration; no independent X/Y scaling. Bounds include antialiased pixels and edited photographic transparency, so are estimates, not certified dimensions.

denseAxialProbe.method: Actual old/new GLBs, all opaque meshes double-sided, both axial directions, 0.25mm cell-centre grid with0.025mm rounded-edge guard. Before samples the formerly claimed physical30x23pane; after samples the explicitly declared30x22clear opening.

windowRefinement.smokeRegression: Full rounded-opening1mm grid plus0.25mm lower-edge samples in both directions; physical30x23panes and glass thicknesses asserted independently. Old37.5mm roof blocks37.25mm; corrected geometry clears that formerly obstructed height.
windowRefinement.limits: No complete eye-box certification. Centreline ±5° and -7° pitch probes clear after correction; -10° still meets the battery, a normal physical off-axis limit rather than a promised unlimited aperture. Photo-derived48.2mm centre and22mm clear height remain provisional art datums.

rearRightRefinement.reason: Owner requested an independent GPT-6.1 Sol reference-difference review, especially the rear-right view, followed by parent-owned iterative fixes.

reviewRounds.findings: Rear cover too short, missing rounded lower bosses, applied adjustment discs, floating rear badge; lower transition, cap/tether and finish discrepancies.

reviewRounds.verified: Main rear-cover anatomy, recessed domed controls, badge seating, nut recess and tether attachments corrected.
reviewRounds.blocker: Degenerate skirt spike and off-plane split normals created a false rounded highlight; cap/mouth ratio and finish/legend polish also noted.

reviewRounds.notes: Skirt/nut normals, cap ratio, rear anatomy and finish separation verified. Moulded detail readability and lighting-sensitive rear mark remain non-blocking; small arrowhead conformance defect reported as P2.

geometry.rearCover: 26mm fastener-row spacing, lower row Z2mm, 9mm cast lower bosses, rounded upper ears/shallow saddle; actual counterbores rather than proud fasteners.
geometry.rearMark: 0.12mm exposed icon relief intersecting the Y-35mm cover; physical shallow lettering, no old 0.72mm air gap. Bundled font is not exact OEM typography.
geometry.controls: 11mm-radius openings cut through hood and overlapping housing/battery; recessed walls/floors, convex moulded annuli, physical tool grooves, seated white print and shallow moulded legends/arrows.
geometry.mount: Open shaped rail channel, contoured lever, oval tension-pad inset and actual slotted nut recess. Still a visual rail approximation, not engineering data.
geometry.cap: 23.5mm nominal grip diameter inside 28.2mm retaining mouth, approximately1.2 ratio; measured peak radius11.74818mm after0.08mm edge rounding; fitted seal/groove floor, tether eyes/loops and aligned crimp sleeves.
geometry.normals: Removed redundant (31.5,8) skirt spike. Native sharp/weighted normals plus explicit planar split normals on axis-aligned sheet/casting/slot caps; no GLB rewriting.
geometry.unchanged: 58.54x73.7x96.47mm envelope, mount origin, optical sockets/datums, pane sizes/thicknesses, clear opening and battery-roof clearance. Frozen studio/cameras/exposure. No reticle/ADS/M4/runtime/economy changes.

finish.maps: Same two seeded1024px procedural PNGs; no photographic textures, new material or new runtime dependency.
finish.note: Native glTF carries the authored scalar roughness multipliers. Finish separation is inferred from photos, not calibrated to their absolute brightness; base colors, metalness and glass settings unchanged.

rearRightRefinement.regression: Actual opaque-geometry probes verify control recesses/domes/slots, lower bosses and counterbores, shallow rear relief, cap/nut groove depth and cap/mouth proportion. Exported hood normals are unit length and stepped face normals planar. Existing full rounded opening/lower-edge, exact-envelope, physical-pane/thickness and source/product provenance checks remain.
rearRightRefinement.comparison: Original seven cameras and lights are unchanged. Reference/before/after rear, right and rear-quarter sheets; quarter reference photo pose differs and is labelled. Filled external-profile IoU is not a detailing acceptance gate: rear/front/top values can decline despite corrected local anatomy; all current measured values are retained above.

postReviewArrowheadCorrection.change: After round3, parent subdivided only the small arrowhead meshes before conforming them to the domed dial, then refreshed native surface normals. No fourth review/remodeling loop.
postReviewArrowheadCorrection.regression: Committed interior barycentric ray probes require the visible arrowheads to remain above the underlying dome.
postReviewArrowheadCorrection.reviewBoundary: Sol's final verdict applies to the stated reviewed hash. This subsequent bounded P2 correction was parent-verified with dense geometry probes, smoke/full tests, repeat builds and native WebGPU; it was not separately Sol-reviewed.

rearRightRefinement.acceptance: No remaining P1 blocker established in round3; acceptable with notes for the named asset-only review. Final bounded arrowhead correction is parent-verified, not separately Sol-reviewed. Owner visual acceptance still required; not certified CAD.

nativeValidation.result: Actual exported GLB loaded with GLTFLoader and rendered using the project's strict WebGPU renderer; two thick glass meshes, local embedded textures, no browser errors. Output-target readback preserves AgX/display transform. Isolated asset fixture, not M4 gameplay/ADS acceptance.
nativeValidation.fixture: Temporary authoring fixture, intentionally not a maintained screenshot-matrix tool.
